newsitem.title: MOZAMBIQUE: Two die in road chaos after Mozambique soccer game.
newsitem.headline: Two die in road chaos after Mozambique soccer game.

text.p: Two people were killed and 30 hurt in traffic accidents as fans went wild after a weekend soccer match between Mozambique and Malawi, Maputo police said on Monday.
Euphoria gripped the 35,000-strong crowd at Machava stadium on the outskirts of the capital when Mozambique beat Malawi 2-1, winning a place in the 1998 African Nations Cup competition.
The home side scored two goals in the last five minutes and fans streamed down the streets in overloaded vehicles blaring their horns into the evening, ignoring the rules of the road, witnesses said.
Police said a 13-year-old child and a man, both Mozambicans, were run down and killed in separate incidents after the Saturday afternoon match.
